OUR WORK

Outdoor work we take pride in.

We enjoy making outdoor spaces work better. That might mean repairing a fence that still has life in it, building a deck where you can sit out, or helping a park manager keep shared grounds tidy and usable.

We start by asking how the space is used, what needs to change and what will be practical to look after. That gives us a useful starting point for discussing materials, access and the work itself.
